description: Report what happened on a call you made or answered: its transcript and/or its structured outcome (e.g. outcome: appointment_rescheduled, fields: { date, time }). Each is recorded once, in your ledger; ORDan adds the call's measured duration.

fields.description: Details of the outcome, e.g. { date, time }

outcome.description: What came of it, as a slug: e.g. appointment_rescheduled

name: ordan.call.report
title: Report a call's outcome
